newsitem.title: USA: US Fed Reg Y proposal unlikely by yr-end - Phillips.
newsitem.headline: US Fed Reg Y proposal unlikely by yr-end - Phillips.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Board is unlikely to consider proposed changes to Regulation Y before year-end, Federal Reserve Governor Susan Phillips said Monday.

"I had been hopeful that we were going to be able to consider it fairly shortly, perhaps even by year-end, but I don't think that's going to be the case," Phillips said at a Bank Administration Institute seminar.
Fed staff is currently looking at some changes related to some pieces of the proposal and are plowing through the public comments received on the proposal, she said.
"I think that the comments are significant enough that we're going to have to take a hard look at them," Phillips said.
The proposal would speed the process for bank mergers for healthy banks and and make it easier for them to engage in nonbanking activities.
